> ⚠️ **Harness boundary — stated because the original OpenCode agent guaranteed
> otherwise.** That agent ran on a local model and could promise "proprietary code
> never leaves the machine." **Claude Code cannot make that promise** — there is no
> local-model path. The control here is the *repository*, not the model: this agent
> runs only against public, synthetic-data-only repos. If you encounter what looks
> like real participant data, a client identifier, or a production figure, **stop and
> report it as 🔴 Blocking immediately** — its presence is itself the finding.
